changes.change: ADDED Scotland-specific operative application: Holyrood toilets interpreted as biological sex; gender-neutral toilets open to anyone.
changes.quote: Trans women will no longer be able to use the women's toilets in the Scottish Parliament building. Facilities designated as male or female-only would now be interpreted as meaning biological sex, the Scottish Parliamentary Corporate Body (SPCB) said. Holyrood is installing new gender neutral toilets which will be open to anyone following the UK Supreme Court's landmark ruling over the definition of a woman.

changes.change: ADDED operative hate-crime framework: no transgender-specific aggravated-offence statute (CDA 1998 ss29-32) + Sentencing Act 2020 s66 sentencing uplift + police transgender-strand monitoring.
changes.quote: 66 Hostility E+W (1) This section applies where a court is considering the seriousness of an offence which is aggravated by— (a) racial hostility, (b) religious hostility, (c) hostility related to disability, (d) hostility related to sexual orientation, or (e) hostility related to transgender identity. / (2) The court— (a) must treat the fact that the offence is aggravated by hostility of any of those types as an aggravating factor, and (b) must state in open court that the offence is so aggravated. / Commencement Information I1 S. 66 in force at 1.12.2020 by S.I. 2020/1236

changes.change: ADDED: aggravated offences are racially/religiously aggravated only.
changes.quote: An offence is racially or religiously aggravated for the purposes of sections 29 to 32 below if— (a) at the time of committing the offence, or immediately before or after doing so, the offender demonstrates towards the victim of the offence hostility based on the victim's membership (or presumed membership) of a racial or religious group; or (b) the offence is motivated (wholly or partly) by hostility towards members of a racial or religious group
